about: Hand review of every problem the automatic checks flag (no optimum, ORLM disagrees, or the optimum is to make nothing). Each reason was checked by hand against the problem text. Reviewed by Claude on 2026-10-16. The owner confirmed (and corrected) every dev review in the dev walkthrough; test reviews await confirmation. Verdicts: text-has-no-optimum (the problem as written is infeasible/unbounded, so that status is the right answer), annotation-error (the annotation doesn't say what the text says; excluded from scoring unless answer_affected is false, and always excluded from blind grading), orlm-error (our ground truth is right and ORLM's answer is wrong), ambiguous-text (the text supports more than one formulation), degenerate-text (as written nothing has to be made, so the optimum is to make nothing; correct but trivial), ok (looked suspicious but the ground truth is right).
